The
Lunenburg Budget Project

67 town reports, 1959 to 2025

8,997 pages the town wrote and printed, one report every year. We went through every one. Some of what’s inside:

Tax rate, 1969
$133.00
per $1,000
Then the town revalued, and the 1970 report prints $33.00. A rate only compares within one assessment.
Homes, 1960
452
camps, beside 1,734 houses
A camp: a seasonal house, not lived in year-round. 21% of the homes the Assessors counted.
School lunch, 1959
25¢
a Type A lunch
The 1959 report counts 126,016 school lunches sold at that price.
Town manager
33 years
from study to charter
A 1966 study recommended one. The 1999 charter passed 422 to 150.

Thank you to every board and town officer who wrote one.
